A1.name: A1
A1.title: A1 · Beginner
A1.subtitle: 入门起步
A1.description: 基础高频词汇、日常问候与简单生活表达

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: delicious
cards.example: “This homemade apple pie is delicious.”
cards.translation: 这个自制的苹果派非常美味。
cards.note: 常用在餐饮与日常生活会话中

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: nice to meet you
cards.example: “Hello, nice to meet you, I’m Alex.”
cards.translation: 你好，很高兴认识你，我是亚历克斯。
cards.note: 初次见面最常用的礼貌问候语

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: comfortable
cards.example: “These running shoes are very comfortable.”
cards.translation: 这双跑鞋穿起来非常舒适。
cards.note: 描述日常穿着、家具或居住感受

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: have a good day
cards.example: “See you tomorrow and have a good day!”
cards.translation: 明天见，祝你度过愉快的一天！
cards.note: 日常道别时的亲切祝福

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: favourite
cards.example: “Listening to music is my favourite hobby.”
cards.translation: 听音乐是我最喜欢的爱好。
cards.note: 表达个人偏好与日常兴趣

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: by the way
cards.example: “By the way, what time does the shop open?”
cards.translation: 顺便问一下，这家店几点开门？
cards.note: 日常轻松转换谈话话题

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: exciting
cards.meaning: 令人激动的；使人兴奋的
cards.example: “We had an exciting trip to the amusement park.”
cards.translation: 我们在游乐园度过了一次令人兴奋的旅程。
cards.note: 描述充满活力的活动或经历

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: take care
cards.example: “Goodbye, take care on your way back home.”
cards.translation: 再见，回家的路上多保重。
cards.note: 温暖得体的道别短语

quizzes.question: 点击词块组装句子：'这个苹果派非常美味。'
听音辨词：请选择你听到的正确单词
初次与新朋友见面时，最得体的问候短语是？
quizzes.explanation: 'Nice to meet you' 是初次见面的经典问候。

A2.name: A2
A2.title: A2 · Elementary
A2.subtitle: 初级进阶
A2.description: 日常生活、餐饮旅行与基础情境表达

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: convenient
cards.example: “Mobile payment makes our daily life very convenient.”
cards.translation: 移动支付让我们的日常生活非常便利。
cards.note: 描述现代科技与生活服务

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: look forward to
cards.example: “I really look forward to seeing you this weekend.”
cards.translation: 我非常期待这个周末与你见面。
cards.note: 注意后接动词-ing形式或名词

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: opportunity
cards.example: “Studying abroad is a wonderful opportunity to learn.”
cards.translation: 出国留学是一个极佳的学习机会。
cards.note: 表达发展机遇与成长契机

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: make up one’s mind
cards.example: “She finally made up her mind to learn a new language.”
cards.translation: 她终于下定决心去学一门新语言。
cards.note: 表达经过思量后做出的决策

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: environment
cards.example: “A quiet working environment helps me focus better.”
cards.translation: 安静的工作环境能帮我更好地集中精力。
cards.note: 讨论生活环境与学习氛围

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: out of order
cards.example: “The coffee machine is currently out of order.”
cards.translation: 咖啡机目前出现故障了。
cards.note: 公共设施和日常电器的常见标牌

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: confident
cards.example: “Daily speaking practice will make you confident.”
cards.translation: 每天坚持口语练习会让你充满自信。
cards.note: 描述积极自信的精神状态

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: pay attention to
cards.example: “Please pay attention to the traffic signs ahead.”
cards.translation: 请注意前方的交通指示牌。
cards.note: 提醒他人集中注意力

quizzes.question: 短语 'look forward to' 的正确意思是？
quizzes.explanation: 'look forward to' 意为期待、盼望（后接 doing/noun）。

quizzes.question: 点击词块组装句子：'移动支付很方便。'
听音辨词：请选择听到的正确单词
当你看到电梯挂着 'Out of order' 牌子时，代表什么？
options: 电梯发生故障暂停使用
quizzes.explanation: 'out of order' 专指机器或设施出故障。

B1.name: B1
B1.title: B1 · Intermediate
B1.subtitle: 中级应用
B1.description: 观点表达、职场交流与常用习惯短语

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: reliable
cards.example: “She is one of the most reliable people on our team.”
cards.translation: 她是我们团队中最可靠的人之一。
cards.note: 用于职场人际评价与产品性能

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: take your time
cards.example: “Take your time — there’s no need to rush.”
cards.translation: 慢慢来——不需要着急。
cards.note: 安抚他人与减轻压力的温和表达

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: perspective
cards.example: “Travel can give you a fresh perspective on life.”
cards.translation: 旅行可以让你对生活有全新的看法。
cards.note: 表达个人见解与宏观视野

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: make it count
cards.meaning: 让它变得有意义；好好利用
cards.example: “We only have one day here, so let’s make it count.”
cards.translation: 我们只有一天时间，所以好好利用它吧。
cards.note: 极具激励感的日常表达

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: adapt
cards.example: “You need to adapt quickly when things change.”
cards.translation: 当事情发生变化时，你需要快速适应。
cards.note: 职场与生活环境变化高频词

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: as far as I know
cards.example: “As far as I know, the meeting starts at ten.”
cards.translation: 据我所知，会议十点开始。
cards.note: 委婉提出已有信息的常用语

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: flexible
cards.example: “My work schedule is quite flexible this week.”
cards.translation: 我这周的工作时间安排非常灵活。
cards.note: 用于日程安排与工作协作

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: on the bright side
cards.meaning: 往好的方面看；乐观地看
cards.example: “On the bright side, we learned something valuable.”
cards.translation: 往好的方面看，我们学到了宝贵的经验。
cards.note: 引导积极视角的转折短语

quizzes.question: 'She is a reliable partner.' 句中 'reliable' 最恰当的意思是？
点击词块组装句子：'慢慢来，别着急。'
quizzes.answer: Take your time, there is no rush.
quizzes.translation: Take your time, there is no rush.

quizzes.question: 听音辨词：请选择听到的正确单词
当你想要引导大家看到不利情况中积极的一面时，可以使用：
quizzes.explanation: 'On the bright side' 意为往好的方面看、从积极角度看。

B2.name: B2
B2.title: B2 · Upper-Intermediate
B2.subtitle: 中高进阶
B2.description: 抽象概念、深度逻辑连接与地道习语搭配

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: comprehensive
cards.example: “The report provides a comprehensive analysis of the market.”
cards.translation: 该报告对市场进行了全面详尽的分析。
cards.note: 学术研究与商务高管报告高级词汇

cards.label: Idiom & phrase
cards.title: read between the lines
cards.meaning: 领会言外之意；读懂潜台词
cards.example: “You need to read between the lines to catch his true intent.”
cards.translation: 你需要领会言外之意才能理解他的真实意图。
cards.note: 高阶职场社交与沟通理解

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: resilience
cards.meaning: 心理韧性；恢复力；抗逆力
cards.example: “Emotional resilience helps people bounce back from setbacks.”
cards.translation: 心理韧性帮助人们在遭遇挫折后迅速重振旗鼓。
cards.note: 高阶心理学与领导力核心概念

cards.label: Idiom & phrase
cards.title: come to terms with
cards.example: “He finally came to terms with the unexpected outcome.”
cards.translation: 他最终欣然接受了这个意料之外的结果。
cards.note: 描述接受复杂现实的情感演进过程

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: subtle
cards.meaning: 微妙的；敏锐的；不易察觉的
cards.example: “There is a subtle difference in nuance between the words.”
cards.translation: 这两个词在细微语感上存在着微妙的差异。
cards.note: 精细化语义辨析与深度观察

cards.label: Idiom & phrase
cards.title: play devil’s advocate
cards.meaning: 故意唱反调；提出反方观点以促进深入讨论
cards.example: “Let me play devil’s advocate to test our current plan.”
cards.translation: 让我故意唱个反调来全面检验我们当前的方案。
cards.note: 团队深度思辨与战略决策必备短语

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: sustainable
cards.meaning: 可持续的；长期可维持的
cards.example: “We aim to build an economically sustainable strategy.”
cards.translation: 我们的目标是构建一个在经济上可持续的战略。
cards.note: 商业战略与全球发展高频前沿词

cards.label: Idiom & phrase
cards.title: hit the nail on the head
cards.example: “Your remark really hit the nail on the head.”
cards.translation: 你的这番话确实切中了问题的要害。
cards.note: 高度赞赏对方洞察力的地道习语

quizzes.question: 短语 'play devil's advocate' 在商务讨论中的真实含义是？
options: 故意提出反方意见以启发思辨
quizzes.explanation: 'play devil's advocate' 意为故意提出反对观点以促进更深入的思考与论证。

quizzes.question: 点击词块组装句子：'该报告提供了全面的分析。'
quizzes.answer: The report provides a comprehensive analysis.
quizzes.translation: The report provides a comprehensive analysis.

quizzes.question: 听音辨词：请选择听到的正确单词
quizzes.explanation: 朗读内容为 'resilience'（韧性；恢复力）。

quizzes.question: 'Your summary hit the nail on the head.' 表达的是：
options: 你的总结一针见血、切中要害
quizzes.explanation: 'hit the nail on the head' 是指切中要害、说得很准。
